nom: Lancôme Tonique Douceur Alcohol Free Toner

avis.texte: Im normally an affordable toner type of person BUT this splurge is honestly worth it! It gives your skin this perfect natural glow without looking greasy. Will be repurchasing for sure!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again
avis.texte: Not too astringent but enough to get the day off of your face.

Tried this because Ulta was out of the milky toner in the pink bottle. It is just okay; for the price point and based on other products. I will use up the bottle but doubt I will purchase again. They need to redesign the dispenser opening because it is way too easy to dispense too much product and that is a waste, especially at this price point.
Lancôme has superior products. I have used many lines of products in my 76 years of life and Lancôme serves me the best.
I've been using Lancôme for 30+ years. Love this toner. I asked my niece (she in in cosmetology school) if she would recommend another and she said there isn't any better.

I wish they wouldn't have gotten rid of the original one. Yes it had alcohol in it, but boy did it clear up my skin. This one doesn't do anything for me and ever since I had to switch, my skin hasn't been clear and it's been a struggle trying to find a toner that will do the same as the original.
It is a great follow-up to my cleansing regimen and does not dry me out. I would buy it again.
This felt immediately heavy on my skin and the fragrance was off putting. I'd like to see Lancôme release a version that is lighter and unscented (or barely scented).
I use it twice daily. If toners aren't alcohol free, I don't use them.

I was recommended this by a Lancôme adviser many years ago. I was using Cliniques toner but it kept drying me out. I switched to this and haven't stopped using it. I would always get the two big sizes during the gifts with purchase. I will never use another toner again.

Use a pure cotton ball to apply. But first clean your skin. I have good skin but large pores in T-spot. I've used Sea Breeze sensitive OTC since high school for breakouts. It contains eucalyptus and clove oils. It goes down into your pores and acts as antibacterial. Use cotton ball with it too. Then apply the toner. Then apply a light moisturizer. Go bare or makeup. Those pre-steps are your defense against makeup getting down in your pores. This toner is also great on lips and nails.

This toner is great! It feels great on the skin, its non-drying and overall my skin just looks and feels better in combination with the Anti-Aging cleanser from Peter Thomas Roth. I started using both at the same time and my breakouts have gone way down, as well as brighter skin.

This works great for me since most toners have alcohol in them and this doesn't. With cold Michigan winters, I don't want my face to dry out and start peeling. It feels good and gets it ready for the rest of my routine.
This toner works well and does not dry out my skin. I often order the big bottle and transfer the product into the smaller bottle for storage purposes.
I love how it makes my face feel afterwards. With cold weather coming soon, alcohol in some toners will dry out your skin. This has no alcohol so I don't have to worry about dryness.
Love this product. It is non drying to my nirmal to oily skin. Been using it for a few days now and I'm loving it so far. I have no reactions to it and my skin feels clean fresh and hydrated.
I checked the ingredients after I caused my eczema to flair up and it states "benzyl alcohol" on the bottle... pretty disappointed because I love Lancôme products

I have struggled with cystic acne for a long time. I have oily skin that is very sensitive. No other toner I have ever used has been this great. In the morning, I now skip using a stripping cleanser and use this instead. My skin has never been better. Breakouts happen less often and my skin always feels hydrated after using this.

avis.titre: Toner saved my skin for the summer
avis.texte: I put it on one cotton round and gently wipe down my face. Then I put moisturizer and a serum on once every night or in the morning too. This routine has helped save my skin especially with this specific toner my skin is much softer, healthier, less breakout and my skin is more alive and less broken.

The first 4 ingredients in order are: water, glycerin, sodium citrate, and artificial color. Essentially this is a bottle of blue glycerin. Glycerin is a good ingredient. It is a humectant that is able to draw moisture from the environment and hydrate the skin. But the rest of the ingredients are underwhelming. There is a strong perfume like smell and enough blue dye to stain your bathroom counter if it spills. There are sooooooo many better toners out there.

Bought this last year, used a few times and it didnt do anything good. It broke me out a little bit and I returned it. Everything by Lancome makes me breakout, I'm acne prone so if you are too ide be careful. There are better options out there with better ingredients. Trust me on that.
I love the line of Lancome skin care products. I use the cleanser, toner, eye makeup remover, and various creams, lotions and serums. Somewhat pricey, but never disappointed.
I've used this product for years and there's nothing like it anywhere. It's so refreshing after cleansing and even applicable on eyes!! While my face is damp I then apply genefique. Love it!

This is my favorite toner hands down. I used this one until I ran out then I decided to try Thayer's since it was less expensive and that one was okay but this one is way better. It leaves my skin feeling soft and actually hydrated! Worth the money in my view!
Good for any skin type. Smells amazing. Doesn't irritate my sensitive skin. An icon.

avis.titre: I'll NEVER use ANOTHER toner again...Amazing!
avis.texte: I'm not a huge fan of Lancôme products. But this one knows it out of the park...Lightweight, small application use (less of the product you need to apply = lasts FOREVER), and a subtle fragrance.

I tried my friend's toner (same brand) and I really liked it so I looked online to see what type of toner I should buy and was reading about not using an alcohol based one so I thought I would try this one out. I absolutely love this toner (never used toner in my life before thought it was a joke) this toner gets rid of excess oil, moisturizes and improves skins appearance! I don't even use face lotion as much anymore because it's that moisturizing.

I bought this on a whim as I wanted to try Lancome products. Turns out I did not like any of their moisturizers but this toner is something else. I use it at night before I apply my moisturizer and the result has been amazing. It cleanses well and moisturizes my skin, makes it look soft and brightens my complexion. I have sensitive skin but this did not irritate my skin and I use this toner combined with a different brand moisturizer which seem to work great. I am a 50 year old lady and the fine lines on my face have been minimized as well. Just remember ladies alcoholic toners ages you, so try this one and you will be happy!

A little pricey, but definitely worth it. I use this twice a day. In the evening to clean my skin after I've removed my makeup and the next morning before I apply my face primer. I'm always amazed at the makeup that comes off after I've cleaned my face at night. I also like using it before I do my makeup routine in the morning to remove any "dirt" from touching my face during the during while I'm sleeping.

Holy grail this product does wonder. Tried it for the 1st time yesterday and again today and my skin felt completely soft and hydrated. I felt like it worked with my other skin care products and not against it. It is defiantly worth the price. Ive had bad experience with toners in the past but this one is far by the best for my skin. Cons are that it can be messy because the hole where you pure the toner out of is large and it is very easy to waste it or use more than desired. Another con is that it has a fragrance. I personally love the fragrance but for someone who has sensitive skin it may not be ideal. I was told it can used for all skin types but because it is so hydrating if one has oily skin it may or may not be too much in regards to hydration. But all in all dont take my word for it. Its a try it for yourself product. Lacome products have never left me or my skin disappointed.

avis.titre: If you are thinking about buy... just do it
avis.texte: I use the product daily it does over dry your skin it leave your skin feeling fresh doesn't over hydrate great for winter would definitely purchase over and over again this brand is amazing and I was shocked by how affordable the price was
I Use this toner every day - gentle and prepares my skin for make up.
This smells sooooo good and feels wonderful going on skin. I'm still a bit oily/acne-prone but may be new Lancome foundation?

avis.titre: By far my favorite toner EVER
avis.texte: I use it morning and night! I have oily skin so it keeps my skin clean and doesnt leave it feeling overly dry (which usually just make my skin even more oily)!

It is expensive! However, it works great and I have some sensitivity to eye products and scents. I have used it for years. I use este lauder double wear and it removes it all! (Can't use the este product take it away because of the smell.)

I love this toner! I am 18 years old and still have my teenage acne prone skin. I save every penny in order to buy this toner everytime. I have extremely oily skin and this toner is just the right amount of moisture my skin needs without breaking me out! I can definately see people with dry or combination skin loving this product just because it doesn't contain alcohol. I apply mine on a cotton round right after I wash my face both day and night. The only con I have for this is the packaging. It is beautiful packaging but the hole that distributes product is quite big so when you go to putting it on the cotton round, if you aren't careful it will distribute too much product and you might end up wasting too much of it. Overall, if you are skeptical of trying this toner out, I say give it a try!
I love this toner, I apply it with a round cotton pad Day and night. It feels so good on my face and neck. I would definitely buy again.
So disappointed. Used it for a week as instructed and it caused small breakouts all over my face.
I use this product every night after cleansing and it definitely gets the job done. It removes every last bit of make up and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed.
I used a whole bottle of this and did not notice any change in my skin. It would also burn when I applied it at times. Will not be repurchasing.
I love this product. It works so well, but it doesn't dry your skin out. It has made a huge difference in my skin care routine. I highly recommend it!
This was suggested to me in-store and I bought without trying. I got home and opened it up and there is a definite scent to it that I can't handle.
Love how this feels!!! Refreshing,non drying, cool to the skin. Not your run of the mill toner!!! A must to have

This is an OK product. I do feel like we are paying too much for something that works well but doesn't blow you away. I also don't like how similar this toner bottle is to their eye make up remover. I once almost doused my eyeballs in the toner instead of eye make up remover. Scary!
I had to return it because of high perfume smell. Not good for my sensitive skin
I.ve been a lancome user for 40 years. I have tried new lines in the past, but always go back to Lancome. I feel I get the quality for the price.

avis.auteur: Busy Mom on the Go, Go, Go
avis.texte: I love this product. Every time that i use it my face feels cleaner and fresh. I use this product after i clean my face with the cleanser. I can literally feel this product cleaning my skin deeply. Sometime I can literally see how well it cleans my face because it will pick up any dirt of left over makeup.
I have dry skin and this does not make me feel dry after use. It wipes away dirt my cleanser left behind and leaves my skin feeling clean/soft.
I was not impressed with this product. It smelled nice but that was about it. It made me get red little bumps on my face and that was when I returned it!
